Lemma
[A Smooth $k$-Form Field Applied to Smooth Vector Fields]

If $\omega $ is a smooth section of $\Lambda ^kT^*M$ at $x_0$ and $X_1,\ldots ,X_k$ are smooth vector fields there, then $x\mapsto \omega _x(X_1|_x,\ldots ,X_k|_x)$ is smooth at $x_0$.
Proof

\sketch In a local trivialization this is evaluation of a smooth family of alternating tensors on smooth vector-valued functions.

□
